title: Maximum Transaction Each Day
summary: For each calendar day, return the transaction IDs tied for the largest amount that day, ignoring time of day.
inputFormat: Transactions(transaction_id, day, amount) where day contains a time component.
tieRules: All transactions tied for the day's maximum are returned.
edgeRules: Time component is ignored for grouping.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.text: authored-reference: two transactions on 2020-01-01 at 09:00 and 17:00 with amounts 50 and 50 -> both returned.
